field.label: Blacklist enabled
field.help: Enable automatic download of the AbuseIPDB blacklist into the pf table.

field.label: Minimum confidence score
field.help: Only IPs with at least this confidence score (25-100) are included. 90 = high-quality hits only.

field.label: Maximum number of IPs
field.help: Upper limit on IPs pulled per run. Free-tier supports 10,000.

field.label: Include IPv6 entries
field.help: The AbuseIPDB /blacklist endpoint defaults to IPv4-only. Enable this to make a second explicit IPv6 call and merge both lists into the pf table. Costs one extra blacklist quota slot per scheduled run.

field.label: Persist days (0 = replace)
field.help: Default 0 = original behaviour: each download replaces the pf table with today's AbuseIPDB top-N. Set to a positive number (e.g. 30) to instead keep every IP for that many days from first sight; IPs that fall off today's top list stay in the table until the TTL expires. Catches sleeper IPs that drop out of the hot 10k but become active again later. Memory grows roughly linearly with the value — at 30 days you might end up with ~50-100k entries depending on overlap.

field.label: Block on interface(s)
field.help: Comma-separated list of interfaces where the block rule is active. Accepts either internal identifiers (wan, opt1, ...) or the friendly names shown in Interfaces → Assignments (WAN, DSL, LAN, ...). Single entry = per-interface rule. Multiple comma-separated = floating rule on all listed interfaces (e.g. "wan,opt1" or "WAN,DSL" for multi-WAN / failover). Default: wan.
